trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The cartoon infers that the mayor is lazy.
trap.right: The cartoon implies that the mayor is lazy.
trap.why: Em português “inferir” é usado para os dois lados; em inglês quem escreve implica (imply) e quem lê infere (infer).

mcq.q: Early surveys **___** a shift in mood.

fix.wrong: He implied that from the text.
fix.right: He inferred that from the text.

rewrite.prompt: Troque por deny: “He refused to accept it without proof.”

rewrite.answer: The theory is refuted by the data.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com infer: “I deduce a motive from his tone.”
rewrite.answer: I infer a motive from his tone.
